title: Smart Vacuum Cleaner
subtitle: An Arduino-Based Automatic Floor Cleaning Robot
desc: A smart robotic vacuum cleaner that automatically detects obstacles and cleans floors using an Arduino-based control system.
fullDesc: The Smart Vacuum Cleaner is an intelligent cleaning robot designed to reduce manual effort in household and educational environments. It uses an Arduino UNO microcontroller, ultrasonic sensor for obstacle detection, motor driver for movement control, and a high-speed fan to collect dust. The robot navigates automatically, avoids obstacles, and demonstrates the practical application of embedded systems, robotics, and automation.
author: Umeshwari Baviskar
innovation: The project combines obstacle detection with automatic floor cleaning using an Arduino-based robotic platform. It demonstrates low-cost automation suitable for STEM education.
problemStatement: Manual floor cleaning is time-consuming and requires continuous human effort. An affordable automated cleaning solution can improve efficiency while helping students learn robotics and automation.
solutionApproach: The robot uses an ultrasonic sensor to detect obstacles and an Arduino UNO to control movement through an L293D motor driver. A high-speed fan creates suction to collect dust while the robot automatically navigates the floor.
guide: Step 1: Assemble the chassis and mount the motors.
Step 2: Install the Arduino UNO and L293D motor driver.
Step 3: Connect the ultrasonic sensor to the Arduino.
Step 4: Install the vacuum fan and dust collection chamber.
Step 5: Connect the battery and verify all wiring.
Step 7: Test obstacle detection and automatic navigation.
Step 8: Verify the vacuum cleaning performance.
